paper_id: Poison Attack and Defense on Deep Source Code Processing Models
title: Poison Attack and Defense on Deep Source Code Processing Models
motivation: SE从业者从开源社区爬取训练数据，但这些数据可能被攻击者植入后门，污染训练集进而控制已部署模型
problem_framing: 将源码处理模型的poison attack建模为攻击者通过篡改训练数据植入触发器(defect detection误判、clone detection失效、code repair注入漏洞)，防御者需在未知触发器类型情况下检测并移除poison样本
key_insight: 源码有编译约束和命名规范限制，不能简单复用NLP的字符级trigger；需利用代码的结构性特征(identifier renaming、dead-code insertion)生成编译通过且人类难以察觉的poison样本
method_signature: CodePoisoner利用规则+语言模型生成代码trigger；CodeDetector用integrated gradients定位influential tokens并通过性能下降探测trigger
evaluation_criteria: 攻击成功率(平均98.3%，最高100%，仅2% poisoning rate)和防御检测率(最高100%)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 虽然rule-based策略有效，但context-free的固定trigger仍有被人工审查发现的风险；LM-guided策略每个样本trigger不同，但仍需依赖CodeGPT生成质量
evidence_for_taste: code embedded with triggers is compilable
triggers still have risks of being detected
the LM-guided poisoning strategy essentially regards the certain distribution
hard for ONION to detect those natural-looking triggers
the rigid grammatical constraint of programming languages
thinking_moves: 发现NLP方法不适配源码约束，遂提出code-specific poisoning策略
从后门攻击的本质出发：trigger是influential且abnormal的token，用integrated gradients探查
攻击与防御的博弈建模：攻击者追求stealthy+reliable，防御者追求complete detection without false positives
将源码的语言学特征(identifier命名、AST结构)映射为trigger设计的结构化约束
